title: Address 7 code-review findings on i18n/lang pipeline (round 2)
description: Follow-up to 08-25-fix-i18n-lang-bugs. /code-review @src/ on 2026-08-26 surfaced 7 new findings: (1) extension.ts:330 error fallback regressed (loses String() fallback when Error.message is null); (2) detectEnvLang duplicates detectLang env-resolution — single-source violation; (3) activation vs listener write override inconsistently; (4) langToggle.ts unreachable defensive branch + missing test file; (5) langStore.ts comment contradicts spec on override ownership; (6) brittle spec line-number cite :20; (7) no dedicated test file for LangToggle. All in src/.
